svg.text: the Heights: a ridge 25-40 m above the quays (new ground, P1)
the cliff's foot (the Crag Men's cliff rises 4 km behind; the site stops here at 1.2 km)
the Ancient town: a grid of 110 m blocks, the ruins of the city the port served (every zone builds on it)
the Bell Hall: the sea temple
the funicular stump up the Heights
(west slope of the Heights, under curfew)
Temple of the Sun on the pad
Hook: the P0 waterfront (to scale), the Ancient town and the P1 site proposal

Kit frame: +z (the kit's S) is drawn UP and is the world's NORTH, the Ring Sea. West is left. Solid boxes = P0 Port segments by decay (d0 light, d1 mid, d3 dark). Grey squares = the Ancient town's blocks, dark diamonds its named ruin hosts. Dashed = P1 zones with their lot mix. Red = avenues and landmarks (P1, P3).
